questions.question: Average age of 3 persons A, B, and C is 35 years while the average age of B, C, and D is 32 years. If A is 3 years older to C and D is 3 years older to B, then find the difference between ages of B and C.

A + B + C = 105 …………….. (1)

B + C + D = 3 × 32

A - C = 3

A = C + 3 ………………… (3)

D - B = 3

questions.question: A Black Panther covers a certain distance in 45 minutes. If the panther runs at a speed of 55 kmph. What should be the speed of panther to cover the same distance in 25 minutes?

Speed = 55 kmph

Time = 45 minutes = \(\frac{45}{60}\) hrs = \(\frac{3}{4}\) hrs

Distance = 55 × \(\frac{3}{4}\) = 41.25 km

Speed of panther to cover 41.25 km in 25 minutes or \(\frac{5}{12}\) hr would be

Speed = \(\frac{41.25}{\left( \frac{5}{12} \right)}\) = 99 kmph.

(L+M)’s 1 hour’s work = \(\left( \frac{1}{10} + \frac{1}{20} \right) = \frac{3}{20}\)
(L +N)’s 1 hour’s work = \(\left( \frac{1}{10} + \frac{1}{30} \right) = \frac{2}{15}\)

Part filled in 6 hrs. = \(\left( 3 \times \frac{17}{60} \right) = \frac{17}{20}\)
Remaining Part = \(\left( 1 - \frac{17}{20} \right) = \frac{3}{20}\)
Now, it is the turn of L and M, and \(\frac{3}{20}\) part is filled by L and M in 1 hour.
Therefore, the Total time taken to fill the tank = (6+1) hrs. = 7 hrs.

questions.question: A 400m long train overtakes a man walking at the speed of 18 km/hr in the same direction in 10 sec. How much time will it take to cross the 950m long tunnel?

[concept :If Two objects are crossing each other then In case of Man or Pole or any objects having negligible length we consider total distance covered as equal to the length of larger object ]

Total distance = 400 m and time taken =10s

So, Resultant speed = 400m/10s

= 40 m/s

= 40 X 18/5 km/h [To convert m/s to km/h we multiply it by 5/18]

= 144 km/h

[ Concept - If two objects are moving in the same direction then resultant speed of the two will be the difference of speed of each individual objects ]

Since the train and man walking in the same direction ,

Resultant speed = Speed of train - Speed of the man

144 km/h = Speed of train - 18 km/h

Speed of train=(144+18) km/h

= 162 km/hr

= 162 km/h X 5/18 [To convert km/h to m/s we multiply it by 18/5 ]

=45 ms/s

To cross the tunnel of 950 m by a train of length 400 m ,

Total distance covered will be 950m + 400m =1350 m

Time to cross the tunnel= Total distance /Total time

= 1350 m / 45 m/s

= 30 sec
